Preparation Tips
It is fun to make ice cream at home, and
several new makers on the market need little,
if any, manual cranking.  Just gather the
ingredients, mix, and follow the manufac-
turer’s directions.  Because homemade ice
cream does not contain the stabilizers and
preservatives of its commercial counter-
parts, it lasts only a few days in the freezer
before it starts to form ice crystals and pick
up the ambient smells.  Therefore, it is best
to make ice cream when the amount made
will be quickly consumed.
